title: Guardrail checks
one_line: Decide allow or deny for an agent action, and fail closed on errors.
verified_against: RBAC and ABAC environments and the pipeline tested in-process with synthetic requests. Not wired into a live agent in any test.
snippet:
from briefcase.guardrails import EvalRequest
from briefcase.guardrails.envs.rbac import RBACGuardrailEnv

env = RBACGuardrailEnv(agents=["bot"], allowed_actions=["read"], allowed_resources=["docs/*"])
result = env.evaluate(EvalRequest(agent="bot", action="read", resource="docs/a.md"))
print(result.effect)
